saw.headline: England *beat Spain 3-2 in Madrid* to top their group
saw.what: England beat Spain 3-2 on Sunday, ending the world champions’ 43-match unbeaten run, per Sky Sports and Metro. Harry Kane’s penalty at the end of the first half was his 93rd England goal, then Ezri Konsa and Ben White made it 3-0. Elliot Anderson was sent off on 63 minutes and Spain pulled two back. England finish top of their Nations League group.
saw.why: A big result against the world champions. Football fans were out in force.

saw.short: Children in Need raises £38.7m on the night
saw.headline: *Children in Need* raises £38.7m on the night
saw.what: BBC Children in Need’s live show on Friday ended with £38,720,170 raised, per the Manchester Evening News. Last year’s final total was £45.5m, so the two figures aren’t like for like. Owain Wyn Evans finished his 400-mile ride in Cardiff with more than £3.85m raised for the charity.
saw.why: A huge TV moment with a strong charity story. The total is one number to quote carefully.
saw.source: Yahoo UK (MEN), 13 Nov; Swansea Bay News, 13 Nov

saw.short: Strictly's judges clash with Lacey Turner and Dani Dyer's pros
saw.headline: Strictly’s *judges clash* over Lacey and Dani as the show heads for Blackpool
saw.what: Metro reports Craig Revel Horwood told Lacey Turner and Vito Coppola “it wasn’t a Foxtrot”, and told Nikita Kuzmin that four lifts in Dani Dyer’s paso doble were “taking the mick”. Anton Du Beke was booed by the studio audience. Will Best and Dianne Buswell went out on Sunday, and Blackpool week is next.
saw.why: Judges’ comments get fans talking all week. Blackpool week next.

saw.short: Pochettino confirmed as Man Utd head coach
saw.headline: *Pochettino* confirmed as Man Utd head coach
saw.what: Manchester United announced Mauricio Pochettino as head coach on Friday, replacing Michael Carrick. The club’s statement says he starts on 18 November, after USA’s games against Haiti. RTE and Sky report a deal to summer 2029, and Sky says Anfield on 22 Nov is his first game.
saw.why: Last week’s sacking story now has a name attached. The next thing to watch is the first game.

saw.short: James Blunt scores a third No.1 album
saw.headline: *James Blunt* scores his third No.1 album with Airplane Mode
saw.what: James Blunt’s Airplane Mode is New at No.1 on the Official Albums Chart dated 13 November, his third No.1 album, ahead of Royal Blood’s Dead Company at No.2. Blunt had joked about changing his name to “Ryan Air” and accepted a fan’s bet about his favourite cheese. He posted an Instagram skit saying he wouldn’t change it, and said the saga “isn’t over”.
saw.why: A running joke with a real result behind it. Blunt’s social presence helped.

saw.short: HBO's first full Harry Potter clip divides fans
saw.headline: HBO’s first full *Harry Potter* clip divides fans
saw.what: HBO released the first full scene from its Harry Potter series, the start-of-term feast, on Saturday during the Kids’ Choice Awards. Fans on X split over the colour grade and joked the food looked smaller than in the original film, LADbible reports. The series arrives on Christmas Day, per LADbible, Inquisitr and TechRadar.
saw.why: A first look at a huge franchise. Early reactions are an easy debate.

platform.short: LinkedIn says it will show fewer AI-generated comments
platform.headline: LinkedIn says it will show *fewer AI-generated comments*
platform.what: LinkedIn’s product chief Hari Srinivasan says new comment classifiers saw views of “slop comments” fall by more than 20% in testing, according to Social Media Today. Suspected AI comments are re-ranked rather than removed. LinkedIn says it will roll out the change to everyone soon.
platform.why: Generic AI comments will reach fewer people. Worth knowing for LinkedIn community work.

platform.short: Facebook will delete additional profiles after 14 December
platform.headline: Facebook will *delete additional profiles* after 14 December
platform.what: Meta says additional Facebook profiles, launched in September 2023, will be permanently deleted after 14 December 2026, according to Social Media Today. Main profiles and Pages aren’t affected. Group admins need to reassign admin before then, and users can export their data. No markets are listed.
platform.why: A deadline for anyone who runs a second profile. Check any group admin roles.

platform.short: TikTok UK's first Live Shopping Report
platform.headline: TikTok UK publishes its *first Live Shopping Report*
platform.what: TikTok UK’s first Live Shopping Report says 32% of LIVE viewers went on to buy a featured product in store, and LIVE sales grew 55% year on year, per ChannelX. The report also says more than 6,000 LIVE sessions run each day on TikTok Shop UK. These are TikTok’s own figures.
platform.why: TikTok is selling live shopping to UK brands. The numbers come from TikTok.
platform.source: Social Media Today, 15 Nov; ChannelX, 11 Nov
